plan.hook: let's make this kitchen california casual ✍️

Pale seafoam shaker cabinets paired with raw wood open shelves and white zellige tile splashbacks. Linen slipcovered bar stools sit at the marble island under woven rope pendants, styled with olive branches in a sandy ceramic jug.
slides.callout: obsessed with this woven pendant light

slides.look: Rich caramel oak lower cabinetry with matte black latches, fluted plaster island accents, and saddle leather stools. A massive fiddle-leaf fig stands beside aged brass dome lights, a neutral jute runner, and handcrafted stoneware bowls.

Flat-panel matte sand cabinets, soapstone worktops, and black cane stools. Glass globe pendants drop from above, illuminating a terracotta fruit bowl, stacked handmade speckled mugs on walnut floating shelves, and an oversized monstera.

Pale ash cabinets with cutout handles, seamless white quartz counters, and slender blonde oak stools. A pair of oversized paper lantern pendants glow above eucalyptus clippings in a rough concrete vase and a simple woven runner.

plan.hook: i'm done with my dated kitchen! 😅

slides.text: forest green makes brass feel heirloom
slides.look: Deep forest green cabinets with unlacquered brass cup pulls, paired with butcher block counters and handmade ivory zellige splashback tiles. Fluted glass pendant lights illuminate matching oak counter stools with woven rush seats, plus stacked terracotta planters.

slides.text: french blue softened with warm honey oak

slides.text: butter yellow always brings the sunshine
slides.look: Pale butter yellow cabinets fitted with matte nickel knobs, colorful terrazzo splashback slabs, and honed black soapstone counters. Bentwood cane barstools sit below milk glass globe pendants, flanked by glazed ceramic pitchers and trailing english ivy.

slides.text: burgundy and marble are pure drama
slides.look: Rich oxblood cabinets paired with honed calacatta viola marble counters and matching splashback. Sleek blackened steel stools with cognac leather cushions tuck neatly under, lit by an aged brass library sconce and a pair of petite oil paintings.

slides.text: earthen tones make everyday cooking cozier
slides.look: Muted sage green cabinets accented with knurled bronze bar pulls, warm soapstone worktops, and glossy terracotta splashback tiles. Sculptural walnut counter stools rest beside an opal glass dome pendant, artisanal stoneware bowls, and potted olive branches.

slides.text: glossy navy with chrome hits just right
slides.look: Inky navy cabinets with polished chrome latch hardware, complemented by crisp white marble worktops and glossy ocean-blue subway splashback. Modern brushed steel stools sit beneath industrial saucer pendants, accompanied by framed abstract sketches and copper saucepans.

plan.cta_look: Dusty rose cabinetry paired with creamy travertine counters, ribbed ceramic splashback tiles, and brushed brass knobs. Blonde ash barstools rest alongside paper lantern pendants, small framed still life art, and an assortment of potted fresh basil.
